    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "TAKE {{ing_01|ELDERBERRIES}} WASH THEM; COOK IN {{ing_02|WATER}}, SKIM AND STRAIN."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "PREPARE A DISH IN WHICH TO COOK THE CUSTARD CRUSH {{ing_03|6 SCRUPLES OF PEPPER}} WITH A LITTLE {{ing_04|BROTH}};"
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "ADD THIS TO THE {{ing_01|ELDERBERRY}} PULP WITH ANOTHER GLASS OF {{ing_04|BROTH}}, A GLASS OF {{ing_05|WINE}}, A GLASS OF {{ing_06|RAISIN WINE}} AND AS MUCH AS {{ing_07|4 OUNCES OF OIL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "PUT THE DISH IN THE HOT BATH AND STIR THE CONTENTS."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "AS SOON AS IT IS GETTING WARM, QUICKLY BREAK {{ing_08|6 EGGS}} AND WHIPPING THEM, INCORPORATE THEM, IN ORDER TO THICKEN THE FLUID."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "WHEN THICK ENOUGH SPRINKLE WITH {{ing_03|PEPPER}} AND SERVE UP."
    }
  ],
